evidence.claim: Treasury said Biden's oil, LNG, and coal ban was meant to deprive Putin of resources for his war of choice.
evidence.title: U.S. Treasury Guidance on President Biden’s Executive Order
evidence.excerpt: Treasury said Biden's oil, LNG, and coal ban was meant to deprive Putin of resources for his war of choice.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous Treasury guidance on an announced presidential action.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Biden’s sanctions decision.
contrary_evidence: Sanctions can increase pressure without quickly shortening war or restoring lawful peace.

evidence.claim: Biden approved an $800 million transfer of weapons and said the U.S. would do everything possible to push for an end to the war while helping Ukraine defend itself.
evidence.title: Biden Signs Order Transferring Arms to Ukrainian Defenders
evidence.excerpt: Biden approved an $800 million transfer of weapons and said the U.S. would do everything possible to push for an end to the war while helping Ukraine defend itself.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary contemporaneous DoD account of a presidential security-assistance decision.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Biden's wartime decision-making.
contrary_evidence: Arming Ukraine can also prolong fighting and carries escalation risk.

evidence.claim: The United States ruled out sending troops or enforcing a no-fly zone because that would risk direct conflict and war with Russia.
evidence.title: Ukraine calls for no-fly zone to stop Russian bombardment
evidence.excerpt: The United States ruled out sending troops or enforcing a no-fly zone because that would risk direct conflict and war with Russia.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting on an explicit White House de-escalation choice, hosted by Nippon.com.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Biden's restraint choices through White House policy.
contrary_evidence: Refusing a no-fly zone reduced escalation but left Ukraine exposed to Russian attack.

evidence.claim: At Madrid, NATO leaders said Russia's invasion had shattered peace in Europe and justified a new security posture.
evidence.title: Speech | NATO Transcript
evidence.excerpt: At Madrid, NATO leaders said Russia's invasion had shattered peace in Europe and justified a new security posture.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official summit transcript from the alliance central to U.S. security policy.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect but strong, as Biden chaired the U.S. role in the summit and alliance line.
contrary_evidence: Alliance deterrence strengthens security but also hardens bloc confrontation.

evidence.claim: Biden approved an $800 million Ukraine assistance package and the report says the package fell short of Zelenskyy's requested no-fly zone.
evidence.title: Biden Announces $800 Million in New Ukraine Assistance, Calls Putin 'a War Criminal'
evidence.excerpt: Biden approved an $800 million Ukraine assistance package and the report says the package fell short of Zelenskyy's requested no-fly zone.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct contemporaneous reporting of Biden's announced action and its restraint limit.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strong direct attribution to Biden's decision, with some factual dependence on reporter framing of the no-fly-zone comparison.
contrary_evidence: The package still escalated military support to Ukraine.

evidence.claim: The Brave Commander carried 23,000 metric tons of Ukrainian wheat to the Horn of Africa, one of the first wartime grain shipments under the Black Sea Initiative, to help feed a drought-hit and food-insecure region.
evidence.title: Bulk carrier sets off from Ukraine with grain for WFP in first since start of war
evidence.excerpt: The Brave Commander carried 23,000 metric tons of Ukrainian wheat to the Horn of Africa, one of the first wartime grain shipments under the Black Sea Initiative, to help feed a drought-hit and food-insecure region.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary humanitarian agency reporting on a concrete shipment and its intended beneficiaries.
evidence.period_fit: Direct August 2022 downstream result of the Black Sea corridor.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect but material: this is an observable humanitarian effect of the peace corridor supported by Biden's administration.
contrary_evidence: This measures one shipment, not the whole war or all food-security effects.

evidence.claim: The ICRC said explosive weapons in populated areas put civilians in peril and disrupt essential services such as water, electricity, sanitation, and health care, with the most severe impact on children, the elderly, and disabled people.
evidence.title: Russia-Ukraine: Civilian lives and infrastructure must be protected
evidence.publisher: International Committee of the Red Cross
evidence.excerpt: The ICRC said explosive weapons in populated areas put civilians in peril and disrupt essential services such as water, electricity, sanitation, and health care, with the most severe impact on children, the elderly, and disabled people.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Authoritative 2022 ICRC field statement on civilian harm and infrastructure damage.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Context only: it is not a Biden action, but it sharpens the civilian-protection stakes of U.S. policy choices.
contrary_evidence: General humanitarian context rather than direct ruler conduct.

evidence.claim: The U.S. privately warned Russia of catastrophic consequences if it launched a nuclear attack in Ukraine and deliberately kept the response vague rather than engaging in rhetorical tit-for-tat.
evidence.title: US Warns Russia of 'Catastrophic Consequences' If It Launches Nuclear Attack in Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: The U.S. privately warned Russia of catastrophic consequences if it launched a nuclear attack in Ukraine and deliberately kept the response vague rather than engaging in rhetorical tit-for-tat.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct report of U.S. private messaging and deterrence posture from Biden's national-security adviser.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Strong direct attribution to Biden's administration through Sullivan's description of private U.S. messaging.
contrary_evidence: The report still concerns deterrence, not a negotiated peace settlement.

unresolved_gaps: Direct 2022 command-and-control and safeguards evidence is thinner than the public nuclear rhetoric and treaty-posture record.
The strongest crisis evidence is mostly speeches and reported private warnings rather than a declassified operational de-escalation record.
Direct 2022 documentary evidence on private diplomacy, ceasefire channels, and partner-use limits remains thinner than the public sanctions and aid record.
National-level evidence on protest policing, retaliation for dissent, and the federal government's leverage over local police remains thinner than the anti-hate and gun-safety record.
Border-enforcement attribution is still mixed because a large share of the harmful conduct sits in inherited systems and sub-agency action.
Direct evidence on state-level election administration, intimidation, and coercive presidential leverage against opponents is still limited.
Household distribution by race, region, and income tier is thinner than the macro and legislative record.
The causal split between Biden-era policy, global shocks, and Federal Reserve tightening remains mixed.
Child care, disability services, and elder-care evidence is still thin compared with health, housing, food, and crisis-response coverage.
The housing record is strong on funding and program design but weaker on realized rent-burden and eviction-prevention outcomes in 2022.
Direct personal-nexus evidence on recusal, ethics waivers, family-business benefit, or obstruction of scrutiny remains thin.
The clearest negative pattern is repeated factual exaggeration in speeches, but the record lacks equally direct correction or retraction evidence.
Independent project-level verification of 2022 execution for CHIPS, IRA, and infrastructure remains thinner than the policy-architecture record.
Community-level outcomes for specific groups and regions are still not well verified in the package.
